about.intro: Kanji Bridge is a personal, non-commercial study tool for people who know Japanese and Korean and want to learn Chinese and Vietnamese.
about.data_sources: : Unihan (Unicode, Inc.), KANJIDIC2 and JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0), CC-CEDICT (MDBG, CC BY-SA 4.0), Wiktionary (via Kaikki/Wiktextract, CC BY-SA 4.0), FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles 2018, CC BY-SA 4.0), libhangul hanja.txt (BSD-3-Clause), ivankra/hsk30 (MIT), OpenCC (Apache 2.0).
about.edrdg: This app uses the JMdict and KANJIDIC2 dictionary files. These files are the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, and are used in conformance with the Group's licence.

notice.content_ja: In this version, meanings, example translations and notes are in Japanese.
overview.page_title: Kanji Bridge: from the kanji you know to Chinese and Vietnamese
overview.meta_description: A free app for people who know Japanese and Korean and want to learn Chinese and Vietnamese: word cards, sound rules, false friends, reading and glyphs.
overview.lead: Learn Chinese and Vietnamese words through the kanji readings and meanings you already know from Japanese and Korean.
overview.free: Free, with no sign-up. Your progress is saved in this browser.
overview.privacy_text: There are no accounts and no tracking. Your progress is saved only in this browser. The app loads its fonts from Google Fonts. Read-aloud uses your browser's voices; online voices send the spoken word to their provider (for example Microsoft or Google).
